source.authority: candidate-only; no physical provider admission, RCL promotion, release promotion or main-branch mutation

change.upstreamTerrainOwner: Large World Runtime terrain sampling and grid mesh
change.providerBoundary: RSR consumes explicit samples; it does not generate or replace Large World terrain

positiveEvidence: The RSR world accepts bounded heightfield fixtures with at least two samples per axis and safe integer samples.
Static and fixed-rotation kinematic terrain providers are admitted; dynamic and rotated heightfields fail closed.
The collision path performs deterministic triangle interpolation, emits an upward support normal and preserves the existing contact, grounded, sensory, snapshot and replay roots.
Kernel RSR lowering accepts explicit camelCase or snake_case heightfield sample fields without substituting another shape.
VSR receives an authored heightfield triangle mesh with the same body/fixture binding and a verified CPU reference frame.
negativeEvidence: No Large World Runtime adapter currently lowers a generated chunk mesh into an RSR heightfield fixture; the cross-runtime physical terrain seam remains open.
The collision candidate is a bounded single support-point/AABB lower-bound approximation, not a full triangle contact manifold or arbitrary footprint solver.
Heightfield bodies are not dynamically deformable or rotatable; terrain-surface exact ray/shape casts are not added by this change.
No physical device, target GPU frame-rate, Android, external network or production terrain deployment evidence exists.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS by source, package tests or CPU reference rendering alone.
